title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC5194 = PGC 47404: inclination 32.6°, major-axis position angle 163°, from its outline at 25 mag per square arcsecond. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 253° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Stars are removed from the picture before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it; 10 of the 10 Gaia stars brighter than G 14 in the picture had a glow, filled out to at most 69 px (30″).

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.366 degrees wide, tangent projection on 202.469547, +47.195151, north up; no crop or resample.
